items.stem: To improve the chance that an answer engine cites your page, you should:

options.text: Hide the key facts deep in long, meandering prose
options.rationale: Buried facts are hard for answer engines to extract and cite.

options.text: Answer the likely question clearly and early, with citable facts
options.rationale: Correct: answer-first, fact-rich content is easier to extract and attribute.
Removing structure makes extraction harder, not easier.

options.text: Fill the page with unrelated keywords
options.rationale: Keyword stuffing does not help extraction or citability.

items.explanation: Correct: answer-first, fact-rich content is easier to extract and attribute.

items.stem: Why is classic keyword rank tracking insufficient for measuring AI-search visibility?

options.rationale: AI answers do mention and cite brands and sources.

options.text: Visibility now depends on whether you are cited or mentioned in generated answers, not just a ranked position
options.rationale: Correct: generative answers require tracking citations and mentions, not only rank.

options.text: Keywords no longer exist at all
options.rationale: Keywords still matter; the point is that rank alone no longer captures visibility.

options.text: Rank tracking is always perfectly accurate
options.rationale: Accuracy is not the issue; coverage of a new surface is.

items.explanation: Correct: generative answers require tracking citations and mentions, not only rank.

items.stem: Which TWO are real trade-offs when deciding whether to allow AI crawler access? (Select TWO)

options.text: Allowing access can increase the chance of being cited in AI answers
options.rationale: Correct: access is often a precondition for inclusion and citation.

options.text: Blocking access protects content but may reduce AI-answer visibility
options.rationale: Correct: blocking trades visibility for control over content use.

options.text: Blocking AI crawlers guarantees higher classic rankings
options.rationale: AI crawler policy does not control classic organic rankings.

options.text: Allowing access removes the need for any structured data
options.rationale: Structured data still aids extraction regardless of access policy.

items.explanation: Correct: access is often a precondition for inclusion and citation.; Correct: blocking trades visibility for control over content use.
